note: One register per claim, every entry authored from the delivered record. compose: two `[[errata.field]]` entries both rename OLD to VALUE and a third corrects the description, all three guarded by the delivered OLD record; the equal assignments do not conflict and the disjoint one composes with them. later: its second entry names the VALUE column that its first entry writes, so it was written against a correction's output, not a delivery. periods: two `[[errata.occurrence_period]]` entries move the 2020 record to 2019 and to 2021. consensus: CVID 501 ('Antal') gets two competing units, one of them 'Kronor', which CVID 502 of the same variable and edition delivers. renamed: one description correction, the allowed twin of step 2's stale one. Setup differences from the replaced tests, which applied hand-built cases to hand-built records: their record had a blank column, which `[[errata.field]]` cannot select (it matches the delivered literal, curation_compile.py `_select_occurrence_correction`), so compose renames a delivered OLD; their conflicting field was data_type, which no `[[errata.field]]` writes and which `[[errata.data_type]]` refuses twice for one target at load (cases/curation_toml/errata-data-type-duplicate-target-refused), so consensus conflicts on measurement_unit, the field whose selection tells two same-edition records apart; the other source row was the conflicted record itself passed a second time, which a build never does, so consensus delivers it as a second CVID. The old exact-period half (2019-01-01..2019-12-31) is errata-period-replaces-only-its-exact-edition.
fails_if: any one of, per register: `apply_occurrence_cases` treats equal assignments from two entries as competing, or applies one correction against another's output, so compose's column or description is withheld or its description entry goes stale (compose); `_select_occurrence_correction` matches `column` against the corrected literal instead of the delivered one, so later's second entry applies and its description becomes 'Changed' (later); `apply_occurrence_cases` keeps one of two competing period replacements or falls back to the delivered scope, so periods forms a 2019, 2021 or 2020 state (periods); a withheld field is read as absent when a state's rows are pooled, or one competing assignment wins, so CVID 502's 'Kronor' becomes the agreed unit (consensus)
